meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 安装后,当你报告 LazyCodex 或 Codex 相关 bug 时,Claude 会先调查并确认问题根源,再在正确的 GitHub 仓库创建英文 issue 或 PR,附上复现步骤、证据和修复建议。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交或分类 LazyCodex、Codex 插件、Codex CLI 等项目的 bug 时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 LazyCodex 的安装器 bug 写个 GitHub issue。
say.note: Claude 会先调查再决定仓库并创建 issue。

say.text: 调查这个 Codex CLI 崩溃的根因,然后生成 issue。
say.note: Claude 会收集证据并路由到正确的仓库。

say.text: 在 openai/codex 仓库为这个插件问题创建 PR。
say.note: 仅当所有权和修复方案允许时才会创建 PR。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you report a LazyCodex or Codex bug, Claude investigates to confirm the root cause, then creates a structured English GitHub issue or PR in the correct repository, including reproduction steps, evidence, and fix guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to report, file, open, or triage a bug in LazyCodex, Codex plugins, Codex CLI, or similar projects.

say_en.text: File a GitHub issue for this LazyCodex installer bug.
say_en.note: Claude investigates and creates the issue.

say_en.text: Investigate the root cause of this Codex CLI crash and open an issue.
say_en.note: Claude gathers evidence and routes it.

say_en.text: Create a PR in openai/codex for this plugin problem.
say_en.note: Only when a fix and ownership allow.
